title: Bohemian Switzerland Day Trip from Prague
short_description: Sandstone rocks, narrow gorges and the Pravčická brána arch, a day on foot in the national park north of Prague. Door to door in your own Mercedes, with one price for the whole car.
description:
Bohemian Switzerland is a national park of sandstone rocks, forested gorges and viewpoints on the border with Germany, north of Prague. It is the best day trip from Prague for guests who want to walk and see landscape rather than a town.

The most famous sight is the Pravčická brána, the largest natural sandstone arch in Europe. The Kamenice gorge, with its narrow rock walls and river, is the other highlight, and in season boat trips run through parts of it. Both walks start from Hřensko, the small village on the Elbe at the border.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague and drives you north to Hřensko. You are dropped at the start of the trails, and the car waits for the time included in your booking, shown next to the price. You can add extra hours when you book. Time beyond your booking on the day is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and your time in the park. You see the total before you pay, and the same car and chauffeur bring you back to your door.

This is a walking day. Trails are steep in places and paths can be wet or icy, so bring walking shoes and a jacket. Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. Entrance tickets, boat trips, guided tours and meals are not included.
highlights: The Pravčická brána, the largest natural sandstone arch in Europe
The Kamenice gorge, with narrow rock walls, a river and, in season, boat trips
Forest paths and viewpoints over sandstone towers
A national park on the border with Germany, reached in one drive from Prague
A walking day with no timetable and no changes
A chauffeur waiting at Hřensko, where the trails start

itinerary.title: Early pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose. An early start gives you the most daylight on the trails.

itinerary.title: Drive north to the border
itinerary.body: The route follows the motorway north, then the valley of the Elbe to the village of Hřensko, right on the border with Germany.

itinerary.title: Drop-off at Hřensko
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur drops you in the village, where the trails start, and tells you where the car will wait.

itinerary.title: A walk to the Pravčická brána
itinerary.body: A forest path leads uphill from Hřensko to the great sandstone arch. The way is steep in places, so go at your own pace and stop at the viewpoints.

itinerary.title: The Kamenice gorge
itinerary.body: Walk through the gorge between rock walls beside the river. In season, boat trips run through parts of it; you pay for them on the spot.

itinerary.title: Back to the car
itinerary.body: Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready. The car is waiting in Hřensko, where you were dropped off.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur bring you back to the same address in Prague where the day began.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
The drive to Hřensko and back
Waiting time at the destination for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: Entrance fees, boat trips on the gorge and other tickets
A guide or a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time. In the park the car waits at Hřensko, where the trails start.
important_info:
Wear walking shoes. Trails are steep in places, and paths can be wet or icy outside summer.

Bring a jacket and water. The weather in the gorges can be cooler and damper than in Prague.

Boat trips on the Kamenice gorge run in season only. Check the dates before you travel.

The park lies on the border with Germany. Carry a passport or national ID.

There is no guide on this trip. Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Entrance tickets, boat trips and guided tours are not included.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and the hours at the destination included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.

faq.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faq.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you to Hřensko, wait for the time you booked and drive you back to your Prague address. Waiting during the hours in your booking is part of the price.
This is a walking day. The path to the Pravčická brána climbs through the forest and is steep in places. The gorge is easier but can be wet. Go at your own pace, and wear walking shoes.

faq.q: Is a guide or a boat ticket included?
faq.a: No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur. Tickets, boat trips and guided tours are booked separately, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.
